caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of decorative shapes on a cream-colored background within a square boundary bordered by a thin gold line. There are eight large, irregular leaf-like shapes filled with small red leaf motifs and outlined in light brown, arranged in a circular pattern. Four bright red elongated motifs resembling stylized feathers or flower petals, each adorned with small yellow dots, are placed in the spaces between the larger leaf-like shapes at the corners of the central square. In the center, there is a red crown-like shape that has a symmetrical design, also speckled with yellow dots, and contains the initials "A.E.G." written in the middle. The design is flat and appears to be made using a combination of solid and patterned fills. The artwork is framed with a narrow border, leaving a wide margin of blank space around the entire composition.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
